item.title: A Tribute to Zubeen Garg: A 30-Year Legacy that Continues to Inspire
item.description: 26th March AEI Field Zubeen Garg is not just a name; he is an icon, a legend whose music has touched the hearts of millions of people. For over three decades, he has been a prominent figure in the world of Assamese music and cinema, contributing immensely to the growth and development of Assamese culture. item.title: Gupshup Bihu Adda 2023
item.description: 13th April 2023 Assam, the land of breathtaking natural beauty, rich cultural heritage, and warm hospitality, is a melting pot of diverse cultures and traditions. One such tradition that embodies the spirit of Assamese culture is the Bahag Bihu, a festival that marks the onset of the Assamese New Year. item.title: Celebrating 20 Years of Papon: A Musical Odyssey at GupShup Blockbuster 2024
item.description: On December 7, 2024, the AEI Playground in Chandmari became a hub of joy and celebration as thousands gathered to honor 20 remarkable years of Papon’s musical journey. Known for his captivating voice, innovative folk fusion, and unwavering dedication to Assamese music, Papon, or Angaraag Mahanta, has become a national treasure and a cultural icon.
